web._comment: LISTENING socket for browsers (the web UI). Unrelated to the HBlink4 event link below. 'bind' is a bind address: '0.0.0.0' for all IPv4 interfaces, '::' for all interfaces on a dual-stack host, '127.0.0.1' for local access only.

event_receiver._comment: LISTENING socket for HBlink4's incoming event connection. HBlink4 dials in and sends the events; the dashboard only sends sync_request back over the connection it accepted. Naming convention: bind_* = an address we listen on, host_* = an address we connect out to. bind_ipv4/bind_ipv6 accept '0.0.0.0'/'::' for all interfaces, or '' to disable that family. transport, port and unix_socket must match the 'dashboard' section of config/config.json.

user_database._comment: Radio ID to callsign lookups, downloaded daily from radioid.net. Only the countries listed below are loaded, so a radio from anywhere else shows '-' in Last Heard. Add yours using the exact name radioid.net uses, e.g. ["New Zealand"], or use "all" (no list brackets) for every country. See dashboard/README.md for when a change takes effect.
